Thiruvananthapuram Mayor Denies Forgery Allegations Amid UDF-LDF Accusations

Thiruvananthapuram Mayor V.V. Rajesh has denied allegations of forging a councillor's signature and stated he will "resist all attempts to level false charges against him." He accused the UDF and LDF of targeting the BJP and defended council records amidst forgery allegations and police scrutiny. The CPI(M) has alleged a conspiracy.
